$comment: The history validator must additionally enforce cross-artifact cardinality and canonical ordering, re-render every template instance and report byte-for-byte, and recompute retained_bundle_digest_v2 from the seven sibling artifacts plus the canonical manifest projection with only that member omitted.

aggregate_input_ref.description: Opaque reference to deterministic terminal-ledger inputs for a retained aggregate.

bootstrap_gap_reason.description: Closed taxonomy for gaps introduced while establishing the v2 retained-history baseline.

campaign_leaf_root_ref.description: Opaque reference to one bounded campaign leaf root; no raw locator or digest is retained.

campaign_page_root_ref.description: Opaque reference to one bounded campaign control-page root.

campaign_ref.description: Opaque reference shared by every segment and the root of one publication campaign.

campaign_segment_head_bindings.description: A noncanonical campaign segment binds the quarantine generation but proposes no canonical successor.

campaign_segment_metadata.$comment: The enclosing manifest declares the cross-field ordinal comparison in x-runtime-constraints; the history validator also reconciles these roots against the campaign tree.

campaign_segment_root_v2.description: Lowercase SHA-256 using domain session-retrospective-campaign-segments-v2, followed by typed C/N frames for campaign_ref and segment_count and ordered O/R/D frames for every 1-based ordinal, segment run_ref, and validated retained_bundle_digest_v2.

rendered_text.const: Detail was not retained under the v2 retained-language policy.

evidence_commitment_ref.description: Opaque field-scoped keyed commitment; never a plain source digest.

non_authorizable_terminal_gap_reason.description: Closed safety, privacy, retention-uncertainty, and missing raw-accounting taxonomy that owner authorization cannot override.

privacy_breach_reason.description: Closed incident taxonomy that marks a terminal privacy or retention breach without owner authorization.

terminal_authorizable_gap_reason.description: Explicit allowlist of gap reasons that may become terminal only with a retained owner-authorization usage reference.

host_ref.description: Opaque field-scoped host reference; host aliases and transport names are forbidden.

key_id.description: Non-sensitive identity key generation identifier, never key material.

execution_kind.description: A campaign root is a retrospective publication or a compliance lifecycle retraction of a prior root.

production_configuration_root_v2.description: Privacy-safe SHA-256 using domain session-retrospective-production-configuration-v2 and ordered typed N/V frames for the four exact active calibration/shadow receipt and model-era provenance bindings.

publication_attempt_ref.description: Opaque pre-tree reference for one publication attempt; no remote transaction identifier is retained.

publication_campaign_reason.description: Closed reason taxonomy for retained publication campaigns.

quarantine_generation_ref.description: Opaque live remote quarantine-generation reference bound by export and promotion.

report_markdown.$comment: This schema validates a decoded UTF-8 report.md value as a JSON string instance. The history validator must also derive it from summary.json and require exact bytes.
report_markdown.pattern:
^# Session Retrospective

## What Happened
[\s\S]*

## What Worked Well
[\s\S]*

## Friction And Confusion
[\s\S]*

## Errors And Verification
[\s\S]*

## Collaboration Patterns
[\s\S]*

## Safety And Privacy
[\s\S]*

## Prompt Improvements
[\s\S]*

## Durable AGENTS\.md Guidance
[\s\S]*

## Reusable Skill Candidates
[\s\S]*

## Follow-up Actions
[\s\S]*

## Confidence
[\s\S]*

## Change From Prior Compatible Period
[\s\S]*
$

retained_bundle_digest_v2.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the canonical eight-artifact retained bundle using the v2 projection and framing contract.

run_id.description: Logical 256-bit opaque run identifier encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Physical history-path sharding is validator-only state.

run_provenance.description: Retained-safe provenance, including only pre-tree remote upload reservation and expected-head values; post-tree upload journals are excluded.

locked_first_parent_object_id.description: Pre-tree locked first-parent Git object ID. This is the exact expected remote quarantine-generation head, not a future commit or transaction identifier.

run_ref.description: Typed reference whose 256-bit payload binds to the logical run_id; the history validator enforces payload and physical-path equality.

source_snapshot_ref.description: Opaque keyed source-snapshot commitment, never a plain Merkle root.

description: Strict retained-history contracts for the eight fixed Session Retrospective v2 artifacts. JSONL definitions validate one decoded line; report_markdown validates decoded UTF-8 report.md content.
title: Session Retrospective v2
